definitions.gloss: hairline; the edge where hair begins to grow
definitions.explanation: The boundary line on the forehead or nape where hair growth starts. Most commonly refers to the front hairline on the forehead.

examples.japanese: {生|は}え{際|ぎわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後退|こうたい}して→後退する：17340_koutaisuru⟧きた。
⟦{前髪|まえがみ}→前髪：19004_maegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生|は}え{際|ぎわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: To tidy up the hairline around the bangs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生|は}え{際|ぎわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後退|こうたい}→後退：12556_koutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にして→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧、{育毛剤|いくもうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: My father started using hair growth treatment because he was worried about his receding hairline.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{生|は}え→生える：02392_haeru⟧ (growing, sprouting — the stem of ⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧) and {際|ぎわ} (edge, boundary). Refers to the line where hair starts growing, most commonly the forehead hairline.

USAGE:
Often discussed in the context of hair loss or receding hairlines, a topic of considerable concern in Japanese culture. Also used in hairstyling and beauty contexts when discussing bangs, sideburns, or nape hair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|は}え{際|ぎわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後退|こうたい}する→後退する：17340_koutaisuru⟧ — the hairline recedes
- {生|は}え{際|ぎわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧ — to be concerned about one's hairline
- {生|は}え{際|ぎわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ — to hide one's hairline
- ⟦{襟足|えりあし}→襟足：18005_eriashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生|は}え{際|ぎわ} — the hairline at the nape

- ⟦{額|ひたい}→額：03579_hitai⟧ — forehead; the area where a receding hairline becomes visible
